import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from dottie.sleep_cycle import SleepCycle, SleepSignal, MemoryCandidate

T = datetime(2026, 10, 30, 3, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

class SleepCycleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_stale_signal_fails_to_unknown(self):
        s = SleepCycle().decide(SleepSignal('asleepCore', T - timedelta(hours=3)), T)
        self.assertEqual(s, 'unknown')

    def test_in_bed_is_not_sleep(self):
        self.assertEqual(SleepCycle().decide(SleepSignal('inBed', T), T), 'unknown')

    def test_sleep_stage_enters_sleep(self):
        self.assertEqual(SleepCycle().decide(SleepSignal('asleepREM', T), T), 'sleep')

    def test_awaiting_sleep_data_does_not_shut_down(self):
        self.assertEqual(SleepCycle().decide(None, T), 'unknown')

    def test_dreams_are_hypotheses_only(self):
        result = SleepCycle().dream(['fact A', 'fact B'])
        self.assertEqual(result['status'], 'unverified_hypothesis')
        self.assertFalse(result['autobiographical'])

    def test_protected_memory_never_degrades(self):
        c = MemoryCandidate('m1', 0.2, True, 'verified')
        self.assertEqual(SleepCycle().degrade(c, 100).salience, 0.2)

    def test_disputed_memory_never_degrades(self):
        c = MemoryCandidate('m2', 0.2, False, 'disputed')
        self.assertEqual(SleepCycle().degrade(c, 100).salience, 0.2)

    def test_low_priority_memory_degrades_without_deletion(self):
        c = MemoryCandidate('m3', 0.8, False, 'unverified')
        result = SleepCycle().degrade(c, 10)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(result.salience, 0.1)
        self.assertLess(result.salience, c.salience)
        self.assertEqual(result.memory_id, 'm3')

if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
EOF
